body: Greg directly instructed Termal::Architect2/session8983 on 2026-10-06 after inspecting kimi_may_review_and_evaluators_stay_claude_or_codex: "figure out repair plan for this, and forward to Termal::Codex" and "I disagree with the direction it took. it should be agent agnostic, any harness could be reviewer or evaluator". Product rule: reviewer and evaluator are harness-agnostic host roles. Adapter-specific transport/isolation implementation is legitimate; hardcoded provider role whitelists and our team operating procedures in role eligibility are not. Repair w-7a5ea1183a8f, architectural plan a24000a711984b23bc7aaf541485af5a, handed to Termal::Codex/session8582. Completion includes all currently registered harnesses; Kimi-only exceptions or renaming whitelist flags do not meet the direction. Preserve authenticated role/child/attempt binding, real read-only enforcement and structured result validation. This is a product architecture direction, separate from agent workflow/review-pair instructions and commit/push authority.
